basic_info.description: Simply divine 3 BR Victorian home circa 1907 on sweet, tree-lined block at Dolores Park. Full of sun & romantic character! Splendid outdoor living with two decks & a deep backyard. A peaceful sanctuary to live in & love as is or develop to suit. Storybook faade on a celebrated SF block. Picket fence & inviting front garden. Living room with fireplace, handsome mantle, big windows. Huge formal dining room with intact wainscot & credenza. Cheery eat-in kitchen has classic O'Keefe & Merrit range, pantry. Walk out to a two-tiered deck overlooking lush greenery. Three bedrooms all on the top floor. Remodeled bathroom with luxurious tub, separate shower. A true original: wood floors, wainscot, built-ins, gingerbread. Sensational, extra deep back yard. Only 2 stair steps from sidewalk to front door. Basement has laundry, utility sink, generous storage space. No-car-needed location near Dolores Park, Bi-Rite, Delfina, Tartine, J-Train, BART & much more. Amazing development opportunities. Downtown views from the attic level. Best weather in the city!
